properties.name: A report or piece of evidence, and an analytic judgement drawn from it, can be recorded with its source grade and confidence as queryable fields, and is never read as a requirement awaiting the owner's acceptance
properties.source: @ajs, 2026-10-19: "Capture + add to phase 6" (capstone and logic trials)
properties.statement:
A line of reasoning from uncertain evidence can record:
- each report as evidence ("the report says X"), with source reliability, information credibility and date;
- each analytic judgement with a confidence level (low, moderate or high, ICD 203 style).
Both are queryable, and the read-back shows them. Neither is listed by loop_status as delivered intent awaiting acceptance.
MEASURED 2026-10-19 in the capstone: reports and assessment parts had to be Requirements. Grades lived only in prose, and loop_status listed 7 "delivered requirements awaiting the owner's word" that were analytic claims. The logic rung saw the same with 19 lemmas.
